summary: HeartSciences Inc. filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, amending its Loan and Security Agreement with Front Range Ventures LLC. Amendment No. 8 extends the maturity of the secured, non-convertible promissory note to the earlier of two business days after the closing of the proposed business combination with Fortitude Mining Holdings, Inc. (announced June 23, 2026) or January 29, 2027. The note accrues 12% interest, compounded annually. Accrued interest as of September 30, 2026 is payable on or before that date, with subsequent interest due at maturity. This is a routine debt amendment, not a special situation.
